title: The Faithful Harbor
author: Hazel Fairweather
blurb: Isandro Nystrom, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
